svg.title: Automation and deployment — protected state, reviewed publication
svg.desc: Scheduled or manual workflows serialize canonical operations through a shared writer lock. The reusable processor restores verified state, migrates, requires the reviewed README to match, and executes selected CLI phases. Full or eligible HTTP 429 partial updates must pass SQLite integrity, projection, and snapshot checks; collection also requires its quality gate. Partial audits need completed confirmed checks, no independent failures, and must skip scraping. Other source denials, mixed failures, and failed validation block publication. Scheduling progress travels only with verified SQLite snapshots. A separate job receives only the README: full nightly collections retain automatic merging after checks, while partial proposals require manual review and merge. Unmerged or rejected state blocks subsequent ordinary mutations and deployment. README projections include English and five translations with localized presentation of identical canonical data; only English controls the reviewed-state barrier.
